entities.name: Sword of the Animist
entities.description: Legendary sword hidden in Nissa Revane's staff, which sprouts vines from wounds; became the Phyrexian living weapon Bitterthorn during her Compleation.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who wields the Sword of the Animist.

events.summary: During Nissa's Compleation her staff fused into her skin as a right arm and the sword became Bitterthorn.
events.quote: The staff was later fused into her skin as a right arm during her Compleation

events.summary: The sword and staff were cleansed of oil during Nissa's un-compleation.
events.quote: The sword and staff were later cleansed of their oil during her un-compleation.

relations.quote: wielded by the planeswalker Nissa Revane
